about: The Mac app's native engine, used for FM-1 Pocket Player's native-compatibility checks. `commit` pins the exact fm1-pocket-mac commit whose Tests/ctest/native_smoke.c (fm1host + wasm3) is built: the nightly job runs it on Linux for every published firmware, and on macOS for the `representative` set (the next night's catalogue uses those macOS results). Changing `commit` re-tests everything. A build that runs slower than real time in the native engine stays experimental on the Mac (it may stutter), unless the macOS run measured it fast enough; `fizz`, the slowest on Linux, is in the representative set for that reason.
